title: Pumpkin Overlay+
description: Instead of a big overlay, carved pumpkins show up as a small indicator.
body:
A nice indicator to know if you have a pumpkin, but still being able to see the game.
A small feature but a good one.
It doesn't block any UI.
Long go the days of being in the end, and ether not seeing the game or not knowing if you have a pumpkin on your head.
With perfect view of the game, and a carved pumpkin indicator.

**The Indicator:**

![The Indicator:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a4e8ed45c51170e40efff413422f050cc658465f_0.webp)

This is the best resource pack you could use for carved pumpkins.
Pumpkin Overlay+ is the best way to see with pumkins!

![logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bb856354e7bbd902c1def09c5a1712c10b9ccfcd.png)
This will help the game be better! It can't get better then this!

**Creator's Notes:**

_TrinixMod's First Resource Pack_

Making this was a fun thing to do, I had to learn how to make a pack, I plan on making more. Not any time soon as my life is very busy at this time. But I have enjoyed making this pack. This is just one small step in learning full Minecraft development, but this was still a helpful Minecraft development skill to learn even if it was pretty simple.
